_comment: Today's buzz layer for the manual report. COPY this to manual_today.json and fill it fresh each run from a live X / last30days sweep, then run the report. 'date' MUST be today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the report refuses to send. Only who's actually in a lineup today goes in buzz_* (availability-filtered). model% = your model's number for that player; ranking ORDER is the buzz signal (no fabricated counts).
slate: 📅 N games today — lineups confirmed / projected (say which).
🔁 Re-run closer to first pitch for confirmed lineups before betting.
🔥 One-line headline on the biggest buzz name today.
dropped: Names that were in posted parlays but are NOT in today's lineups (injured/scratched).
flags: Confirmed or projected — state it plainly.
Anything that moves a featured play.
trending: What content accounts / sharps are pushing today — verify each name is in a lineup.
K-prop volume note (light early, fills closer to game time).
tweets: 🔒 Lock tweet — today's safest play + model % + [link] #MLB #PropBets
💣 HR-buzz tweet — the convergence name (slips + model agree) + [link]
🎰 Parlay tweet — your safe 3-leg, different games + [link]
